description: Submission of Regulations made under the Motor Traffic Act making it compulsory to wear seat belts by passengers in vehicles traveling on expressways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Motor Traffic (Expressway) Regulations, No. 2 of 2011 made under the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203) have been amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2455/29 dated 2025-09-25 in order to minimize the number of deaths and serious injuries caused due to the increase of road accidents on expressways daily whereby it has been made mandatory for all seated passengers traveling in a motor vehicle on expressways to wear seat belts.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Acting Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the amended Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
